CREATE PROCEDURE CDN.MobBI_EksportKonfig @OpeIdent nvarchar(8) AS DECLARE @UserAccount varchar(100) SELECT @UserAccount = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Ope_NTKonto,'')='' THEN Prc_NTKonto ELSE Ope_NTKonto END FROM CDN.OpeKarty LEFT JOIN CDN.PrcKarty ON Ope_PrcNumer = Prc_GIDNumer WHERE Ope_Ident = @OpeIdent DECLARE @MetaDb varchar(100) SELECT @MetaDb = Kon_Wartosc FROM CDN.Konfig WHERE Kon_Numer = 5005 DECLARE @MetaSrv varchar(100) SELECT @MetaSrv = Kon_Wartosc FROM CDN.Konfig WHERE Kon_Numer = 5011
SELECT @MetaSrv As MetaServer, @MetaDb As MetaDatabase, @UserAccount As UserAccount
